_comment: Hand-kept, reviewed in PRs. The patterns: the shells a page, a card, a section, a table or an overlay is built from. Each row keeps only what source cannot say, its group and when to reach for it; the import line and the Storybook page come from the barrels and source, through the DS facts (scripts/lib/ds-facts.mjs). Rendered into components/index.md by npm run generate:agent; scripts/lib/patterns-index.mjs holds every name to the facts and every pattern to a row.

patterns.name: Frame
patterns.use: Every full page: the app frame (Sidebar, Page with its 12-column content grid, and Panel, with no top bar). The default template puts the PLUS `Sidebar` (@/components) in `sidebar` and a `Breadcrumb` in `header`; the focused template, for one task the person finishes or leaves, has no `sidebar`, `width="reading"`, the task's name as the `h1` in `header`, and `onBack` and `onClose`.

patterns.name: PatternSidebar
patterns.use: The Frame's Sidebar with its open tabs. The PLUS `Sidebar` (@/components) fills it from the role's config; reach for this only for a sidebar that is not the app's.

patterns.name: Page
patterns.use: A tokenized box with a level (fill and shadow together), a pad and a radius. The Frame draws the page's own; use it for any other block that needs a level.

patterns.name: PatternSection
patterns.use: A span of the page grid under one heading, with its header, toolbar and tabs. No box of its own: the Page supplies the pad. `detail` for a list with a detail region.

patterns.name: PatternCard
patterns.use: A raised container for one object: a student, a session, a metric. Optional image, a header over the body, optional footer.

patterns.name: PatternTable
patterns.use: How a table sits on a page: inside a Section whose header carries the title and toolbar, with slots for pagination and the empty state.

patterns.name: PatternModal
patterns.use: The modal's layout, drawn inline: title, body and footer, width a step of the screen grid. For a working dialog (Backdrop, focus trap, Escape) use the `Modal` component, which draws the same layers.

patterns.name: Backdrop
patterns.use: The full-screen layer under a modal. PatternModal brings its own; use it alone only for a new blocking layer. A Panel floats with no Backdrop.

patterns.name: Popup
patterns.use: The Popups pattern is four floating layers that never block the page, each a component: `DropdownMenu` lists actions, `Popup` holds a small aside anchored to a control, `Flag` reports what just happened, `Tooltip` names a control.

patterns.name: AiChat
patterns.use: AI chat as a popup, in the Frame's Panel or full screen, opened from one floating button.
